title: Show the remaining gem count
description: Improve renderer.mjs statusText so the player sees how many gems remain during play. Keep this task independent of controls.mjs and game rules.
acceptanceCriteria: During play the status includes Remaining gems: N, initially 5 and then 4 after one collection. Winning status still clearly says You won! and Score: 5 and includes Remaining gems: 0. Add tests in tests/renderer.test.mjs covering these states. Existing tests pass. Change only renderer.mjs and tests/renderer.test.mjs.

title: Restart the game with the R key
description: Improve controls.mjs handleKey to call the supplied onRestart callback when the player presses r or R. app.mjs already provides this callback. Keep this task independent of renderer.mjs and game rules.
acceptanceCriteria: Pressing r or R invokes onRestart exactly once, prevents browser default handling, and returns true. Other keys retain existing behavior. Add tests in tests/controls.test.mjs for both restart keys and unchanged movement. Existing tests pass. Change only controls.mjs and tests/controls.test.mjs.
